reviews.text: This has been a game changer to my PM routine. My skin absorbs products so much better and my skin feels smoother and clearer. For having sensitive skin, I was concerned that my skin wouldn't tolerate spicule serums but VT is gentle enough for daily use while also being effective.
reviews.zh: 呢款真係為我嘅晚間護膚程序帶嚟大改變。我嘅皮膚吸收其他產品更加好，皮膚感覺更順滑、更清透。因為我嘅皮膚敏感，我之前擔心皮膚受唔受得住 spicule 精華，但係 VT 夠溫和，可以日常使用，同時又有效。

reviews.text: Good u feel a little bit uncomfortable when putting the cream
reviews.zh: 好，搽面霜嗰陣你會感覺有少少唔舒服。

reviews.text:
Review

I really like the ingredients and how my skin feels after applying it. I’ve only been using it for a few days so far, so it’s still too early to say much about the results. The formula feels pleasant, and I think I need to use it for at least a couple of months to really understand the long-term effect.
reviews.zh:
評論

我真係好鍾意佢嘅成分，同埋搽咗之後皮膚嘅感覺。我到而家只係用咗幾日，所以仲未可以講太多效果。個配方感覺好舒服，我諗我最少要用多幾個月，先真正明白長期效果。

reviews.text: “VT skincare products are well known for improving skin texture, hydration, and overall radiance. The VT Reedle Shot line, in particular, is praised for helping other skincare products absorb better and leaving skin smoother over time. Some users experience a mild tingling sensation, so it’s best to start with a lower strength if you have sensitive skin.”
reviews.zh: 「VT 護膚產品以改善肌膚質地、補水同整體光澤而聞名。特別係 VT Reedle Shot 系列，因為有助其他護膚品吸收得更好，並令肌膚隨時間變得更加順滑，所以備受好評。有部分用家會有輕微嘅刺麻感，所以如果你皮膚敏感，最好由較低強度開始用。」

reviews.text: A really nice bundle! I use the VT shot 1-2 times a week on my sensitive, acne prone skin. I notice immediate smoothness and the tingle feeling isn’t too bad. No redness or irritation immediately after use. Time will tell if the increased turnover of skin will be a concern for me. My skin feels smooth and hydrated after, especially when paired with the serum.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅套裝！我每星期用 VT shot 一至兩次，我嘅皮膚係敏感易生暗瘡嘅類型。我即刻感覺到皮膚順滑，而刺麻感唔算太強。用完即刻冇泛紅或者刺激。皮膚更新加快會唔會成為我嘅問題，要等時間先知道。用完之後，皮膚感覺順滑又補足水分，特別係配合精華一齊用嗰陣。

reviews.text: I was a little nervous to try this at first because of the tingling sensation people talk about, but it ended up feeling really refreshing. My skin looked smoother and more glowy after a few uses, and skincare products absorbed much better afterward. The texture is lightweight and not sticky at all. Great starter version of Reedle Shot!
reviews.zh: 一開始因為大家講嘅刺麻感，我有少少擔心去試，但係最後感覺好清爽。用咗幾次之後，皮膚睇落更加順滑、更有光澤，之後搽其他護膚品都吸收得好好多。質地輕盈，完全唔黏。Reedle Shot 嘅入門版本好好！

reviews.text: It’s my third repurchase of this essence. I believe that it’s very effective but gentle. It helped my skin to be more smooth and shiny. I’m using it over a year now and will repurchase it forever. Texture is very light, absorbing quickly. Skin feels great after applying it. Using it daily
reviews.zh: 呢款精華係我第三次回購。我相信佢好有效，但係又好溫和。佢幫我皮膚變得更加順滑、更有光澤。我用咗超過一年，會永遠繼續回購。質地非常輕盈，吸收好快。搽完之後皮膚感覺好好。我每日都用。

reviews.text: I love it sooo much. Can be used as a base for all serums, including the retinol based. I prefer to finish off with the barrier cream on top. My skin never looked better - smooth, moisturised, wrinkles are going. No issues with the spiculrs, although my skin is sensitive. Top top top
reviews.zh: 我真係超～級鍾意！可以做所有精華嘅底層，包括 retinol 類嘅精華。我更加鍾意最後用屏障霜收尾。我嘅皮膚從來冇咁好睇過——順滑、滋潤，皺紋都正在消失。我嘅皮膚雖然敏感，但係 spicules 冇任何問題。Top top top
